# Security policy

Report a vulnerability privately, never in a public issue, because a public
report shows the flaw to everyone before a fix exists.

## How to report

Use either route:

- GitHub's private vulnerability reporting, from
  [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/meowshed/meowpaw/security/advisories/new)
  on the repository's **Security** tab.
- Email to `me@retran.me`, the address the repository's licence headers
  publish.

Say which unit and which version the report is about, what an attacker can
do, and the smallest steps that reproduce it.

## What happens next

I read each report and either confirm it or say why it isn't a vulnerability.
I fix a confirmed one in a release. This policy promises no response time,
because one person maintains the project and a promise nobody can keep is
worse than none.
